name: Ettie Simons
locations: Covert Township, Van Buren County, Michigan
sources: Brendan Adams, 2026-09-22; named in Raymond Zell Simons's record ("Siblings listed: Ettie, Lola, Bertha")
Family research emails, 2011–2013 (John and Barbara Adams with Irma Kulp Zacher, George F. Adams, Bill Allen and others)
FamilySearch, Michigan, Births, 1867-1902, Van Buren County, item 1, p. 358, no. 4556 (Ray Simonds, 14 Jun 1897, South Haven), with the register images (film 004207534, images 474 and 476)
Ancestry.com, public member tree of Ed Simons (tree 189265374)
notes: Sister of Raymond Zell Simons. Recorded under her birth surname Simons; she likely took a husband's surname, which is not recorded.
Aunt of Raymond Zell Simons, her sister Gertrude's son, who was raised in the household as a brother (Michigan birth registers; 1900 census).
Etta May Simons married August Henry Dunker and died 17 Sep 1970 at Olympia, Thurston County, as Etta M. Dunker (Washington death records). Ed Simons's tree gives her birth as 1 Dec 1883.
